sentences.en: The giant kelp canopies tower above the ocean floor.
sentences.zh: 巨大的海藻林高耸在海底之上。

sentences.en: Kelp is the backbone of Monterey Bay coastal ecology.
sentences.zh: 海藻是蒙特雷湾沿海生态系统的支柱。

sentences.en: Among the kelp blades live a variety of fish - particularly juveniles.
sentences.zh: 海藻叶片间生活着各种鱼类——尤其是幼鱼。
